patch_description: Replace the slower, parameterized chain with the stronger three-scale fixed CZ butterfly seen in the best prior candidate, eliminating two distinct entangling parameters and reducing the total to three. Then stack a second identical mixer–butterfly–tilt layer while reusing all parameters. This increases multiscale propagation and noncommuting expressivity without enlarging the optimization space, aiming to improve worst-group separation, parameter efficiency, and few-shot generalization.
